intro: In southwestern Westfall, Moonbrook lies under Defias control, its streets emptied of peaceful residents. The Brotherhood uses the town as a guarded screen for its hidden headquarters in the Deadmines.

p: Before the First War, Moonbrook stood at the heart of Westfall’s breadbasket, supporting farming families and the gold shafts of the Deadmines. The Old Horde razed the town, but it was rebuilt after the Second War. Its peace did not last. The House of Nobles in Stormwind neglected the settlement, and its military protection was stripped away. Unable to resist the red-masked bandits, Moonbrook’s people were driven from their homes. Citizens and teachers fled toward Sentinel Hill and Elwynn Forest.
